goodsReturns.title: Returns
goodsReturns.description: Return requests from buyers, goods received against your purchase orders and credit notes.
goodsReturns.disabled: Purchase orders, goods receipts and returns are switched off.
goodsReturns.emptyDescription: When a buyer asks to send goods back, the request shows up here.
goodsReturns.meta: {units} units, about {amount} before GST, requested {date}, purchase order {po}

detail.title: Return {number}
detail.subtitle: From goods receipt {grn} on purchase order {po}
detail.rejectedNote: You rejected this return. Your reason: {reason}
detail.disputed: The buyer opened a dispute about it.
detail.approvedNote: You approved this return. Wait for the goods, then confirm receipt and record your credit note.
detail.shipped: The buyer sent the goods back: {ref}
detail.credited: Credit note {number} for {amount} dated {date} was recorded. It reduces the buyer's payable on the invoice.

decide.title: Approve or reject
decide.hint: Approving tells the buyer to send the goods back. If you reject, give a reason: the buyer can open a dispute.

receive.title: Goods back with you
receive.hint: Confirm when the returned goods reach you. You can also record the credit note without waiting.

credit.title: Record your credit note
credit.noInvoice: Record your invoice for this purchase order first. A credit note reduces what the buyer owes on an invoice.
credit.hint: Enter the credit note you issued to the buyer for this return (estimated {estimate} before GST). It reduces the buyer's payable. The platform does not issue credit notes.
credit.numberHint: Up to 16 characters: letters, digits, hyphen, slash.
credit.irnHint: 64-character e-invoice reference, if you reported the credit note to the portal.

panel.title: Goods received
panel.none: The buyer has not recorded a goods receipt yet.
panel.matchIntro: Each invoice is compared with the quantity the buyer accepted and the purchase order price. Differences up to {qty}% in quantity and {price}% in price are within tolerance.
panel.mismatchHint: The buyer may hold payment until this is resolved. Void and re-record the invoice, or agree a return and credit note.
